name: Apple Pie
description: Caramelized, oven roasted BC Honeycrisp apples in a warm spiced ice cream base, speckled with house-made buttery pie crust pieces. Your favourite fall desert in ice cream form.

name: Cardamom
description: Our organic cardamom comes to us from our friends at the Gathering Place, a family run business on Cortes Island.

name: Pumpkin Pie
description: Everything you love about pumpkin pie, frozen. Pumpkin is stewed low and slow with organic spices until deeply sweet and fragrant, then blended into our creamy dairy base. Flaky pie crust pieces add a satisfying crunch to each spoonful.

name: Sticky Toffee Pudding
description: Just like the quintessential British dessert! Bites of moist date cake are swirled with ribbons of rich toffee sauce into a warmly spiced ice cream. The result is a decadent flavour full of lovely cake texture and a delectable balance of sweet and spice.

name: Vegan Apple Crisp
description: BC Honeycrisp apples roasted with brown sugar and whiskey for a lovely caramelized flavour. Swirled into a lightly spiced oat-coconut base, along with generous handfuls of oat crisp crumble. Like a warm apple crisp a la mode!

name: Almond Croissant
description: Double baked buttery croissant pieces with toasted almonds are folded into a light almond ice cream base. The result is a flakey, nutty, buttery, sweet toasted treat!

name: Chocolate
description: Smooth, creamy, and oh-so-chocolatey! This ice cream is a lovely balance between our Milk Chocolate and Serious Chocolate flavours, and is sure to satisfy any chocolate-lover.

name: Chocolate Orange Stracciatella
description: Inspired by Terry’s classic holiday treat. Fine flakes of dark chocolate (stracciatella) in a chocolate orange ice cream create a sensational mouth feel with a classic holiday pairing.

name: Cookies + Cream
description: Organic Chocolate Vanilla Cream Sandwich Cookies, featuring a darker chocolate flavour profile with a crisp cookie crunch. It’s all about the cookies, like a spoonful of childhood!

name: London Fog
description: Made with Assam and Darjeeling black tea, bergamot and vanilla, this ice cream flavour is based on the popular drink which was invented in Vancouver!

name: Matcha Green Tea
description: Our matcha green tea powder is supplied by Aiya and grown in Nishio, a historic tea cultivation region in Japan, from a family owned and operated farm for the last 125 years. It’s a shade-grown matcha, giving it light colour and caramel notes. Aiya are dedicated to giving back to the world through helping with the reforestation of mangrove and mahogany forests in Southeast Asia. We simply blend the matcha powder straight into our ice cream base!

name: Mint Chip
description: The classic mint chocolate ice cream made with lots of house made dark chocolate chips! Like peppermint patty but better. No artificial food colouring is added so it’s white, not green. Fresh and minty, with the added crunch from the dark chocolate flakes.

name: Salted Caramel
description: A classic for good reason. We’ve been making this one since day one and it remains a favourite still. Deeply caramelized sugar mixed with cream and salt from Vancouver Island Sea Salt Co. Its rich, creamly and buttery and the perfect balance of salty and sweet.

name: Strawberry
description: Local strawberries from Mandair Farms are picked at the peak of the season and frozen to preserve their vibrant fruitiness to enjoy in winter. We add a touch of white balsamic to enhance and balance the natural sweetness of the strawberries. A must try for fans of strawberry ice cream!

name: Tahitian Vanilla
description: This flavour has been a core since day one. Our pure vanilla extract is sourced from premium slow-grown, sun-cured vanilla beans of the “Tahitian” variety. The flavour from the beans is cold-extracted to preserve its complex bouquet. These vanilla beans are brighter and more floral than the rounder, woodsier Madagascar variety.

name: Vegan Cookie Butter
description: House-made speculoos cookies are combined in a variety of ways into this delectable ice cream! Rich cookie butter sauce is swirled throughout a light cookie base, alongside a sprinkle of crisp cookie crumble.

name: Vegan Cookies + Cream
description: A vegan twist on a childhood favourite that is brimming with chunks of cookies in a creamy vanilla base. Fun fact, we make this flavour with the exact same organic chocolate sandwich cookies we use in our dairy cookies and cream!

name: Vegan Raspberry
description: One of our original vegan flavours. Local raspberries from Mandair Farms pureed and blended into our signature vegan coconut base – it’s bright, tart, refreshing and looks as good as it tastes.

name: Vegan Turtles
description: Our take on the classic confection, an array of textures and sweet-salty flavours result in a wonderfully complex yet nostalgic ice cream. A lightly nutty pecan praline ice cream is speckled with thin chocolate flakes, salty roasted pecans, and sweet pockets of oozy caramel.

name: Whiskey Hazelnut
description: An Earnest Ice Cream original, made from day one and remains a favourite and top-seller. Roasted, salted BC hazelnuts in Whiskey ice cream base. A smooth, boozy flavour with a buttery crunch.

name: Baklava Sammie
description: Fluffy vanilla cake paired with our Baklava Ice Cream – buttery layers of phyllo pastry and nuggets of spiced nuts are generously scattered through a lightly spiced honey base. Like a slice of honey-drenched baklava made into an ice cream sammie!

name: Chocolate Amaretto Sammie
description: This flavour is perfect for amaretto lovers! Our amaretto ice cream paired with chocolate chips all sandwiched between chocolate cake and finished with a thin layer of amaretto-fudge sauce. A hint of almond extract adds extra depth, but worry not – it’s made with other natural flavours and does not contain almonds! Amaretto dregs are sourced through our friends at Sons of Vancouver Distillery.

name: Classic Sammie
description: Our take on a classic ice cream sandwich. Tahitian vanilla ice cream is sandwiched between chocolate cake and finished with a thin layer of fudge sauce. This flavour never goes out of style!

name: Vegan Coconut Dulce Latte Sammie
description: Strong, creamy coffee balanced by the sweetness of our house-made coconut dulce sauce! Finished with a crunchy coconut streusel and toasted coconut flake for an extra bite of toasty deliciousness.

name: Vegan Grasshopper Pie Sammie
description: This vegan flavours pays homage to the classic Grasshopper Pie. Fluffy mint ice cream with our signature chocolate cream cookies throughout sandwiched between a rich fudgey layer and chocolate cake.
